q1_what_did_you_play: I played Fwoosh! on Shrinker Beetle, then Kaboom! on Shrinker Beetle, then Duck and Cover. This spends 1 Spark and 2 Energy, deals 15 total damage, gains 5 Block, and leaves 1 Energy and 1 Spark unused.
q2_other_line_considered: Dodoco Blast + Kaboom! + Duck and Cover. That line would spend both Sparks and hit all enemies for 7, but with only Shrinker Beetle on the board Fwoosh! is strictly better: it deals 8 damage for 1 Spark.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Dodoco Blast's all-enemies effect and the use of the second Spark. On this single-enemy board, that means forgoing a 7-damage AoE hit in favor of an 8-damage single-target hit, and it leaves 1 Energy and 1 Spark unused.
q4_different_intent: No. A different intent would not change the line: the board has one enemy, so Fwoosh! still beats Dodoco Blast, and Duck and Cover is already played with spare energy. An attack intent would make the Block more relevant, but it would not make Dodoco Blast preferable or remove Duck and Cover.
